title: Come rendere trasparente il tuo uso dell'AI quando scrivi un contenuto
author: Fabio Chinaglia
extra_notes: Register opened before writing began. Case run in light mode until the icon was requested, then moved to full: nothing was lost, the register is the same file. The text was drafted by the language model on the author's instruction, from the author's own methodological document, and then revised with him across twenty-two versions — the measurement says the words are 46.0 per cent the model's and the ideas none of them, which is the shape of a text whose content existed before its sentences did. Sealed on 22 August 2026. Reopened on 23 August to repair the verification page, to correct this note, and to declare the sixteen changes the register names and no span carries; the seal of 22 August is kept as events.jsonl.v1.* and a new one follows the manifest recorded at the end of the register. Published at the address below, where the earlier version of this note said it was not.
